title: Professor, Associate Professor, and Assistant Professor
qualification: Doctoral degree in relevant subject with required years of experience and publications for Professor/Associate Professor; Master's degree with NET for Assistant Professor.
salary: Academic Level 14 (Rs.1,44,200/-), Academic Level 13A (Rs.1,31,400/-), Academic Level 10 (Rs. 57,700/-)
age_limit: Professor:Max 55 years. Relaxation: SC/ST as per Govt norms, OBC 3 years, PwBD 10 years. || Associate Professor:Max 50 years. Relaxation: SC/ST as per Govt norms, OBC 3 years, PwBD 10 years. || Assistant Professor:Max 40 years. Relaxation: SC/ST as per Govt norms, OBC 3 years, PwBD 10 years.
selection_process: Shortlisting based on academic and career performance || Presentation/Seminar/Interview
